Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the factual codes, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Role looks like trader/importer-distributor of die-casting and machine-tool components rather than a pure manufacturer — role category should be reviewed (trader / manufacturer_trader). Revenue and export volume: null — not public in the free views, not invented. Industry claim "Металлургия и горнодобыча" is only partly consistent: die-casting moulds and machine-tool parts fit metalworking, but no mining evidence was seen.
